'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|I told you the driver knows the right paths! That's where I'll send the shipment, although I don't have time for that at present. First I have to deal with those who killed my couriers. I already found the culprits, so now it's for Ragman to send his regards. I can't do anything to help the driver until this matter is handled. That's why I suggest you take care of it. Quicker you start, quicker you finish.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 7 [[Scavs]] in one raid on [[Ground Zero]]
* Survive and extract from the location

==Rewards==
* +24,100 [[EXP]]
* [[Ragman]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.03'''</font>
* 124,000 Roubles
** 130,200 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 142,600 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[IOTV Gen4 body armor (Assault Kit, MultiCam)]]
{{quote|That's great! Now there is nothing to interfere with my operations, and we can think about expansion. For now, I need to figure out how to prepare for the BTR coming under my roof. Just be patient for a little longer.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to eliminate 7 [[Scavs]] on [[Ground Zero]] in a single raid and survive.
